title: teucrium scorodonia var. pseudoscorodonia
intro: Teucrium scorodonia var. pseudoscorodonia, commonly known as Woodland Germander, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Woodland Germander include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Woodland Germander include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects and potential health benefits.
